_doc: Great War detonation and crater sites, imported from the Fallout Universe KML (source-maps/fallout-universe-map.kml, snapshot 2026-07-26) by docs/changes/map-timeline/trace/kml_blast_sites.py. Coordinates are the KML's own lon/lat, which the owner made canonical for site geography; x/y is that coordinate through the shipped atlas-georef.json, so these sit in the same frame as the pins and regions. NOT the whole 'Great War' folder: that holds 245 placemarks, most of them checkpoints, crashes, ruins and looting rather than detonations.
